units.source_text: 那只不过是一桩随处都会存在的小小的恋爱事件罢了。

en.t: It was merely a small love affair of the kind that could happen anywhere.

units.source_text: 也只不过是同双亲不允许的对象进行不幸的不请世故的恋爱罢了。

en.t: It was only an unhappy, naive romance with someone her parents would not allow.

units.source_text: 大概这是写信的鹤川本人不觉间犯了感情的夸张吧。

en.t: Most likely, Tsurukawa, who wrote the letter, had unconsciously exaggerated his feelings.
The following passage left me stunned.
